domains.title: Domains or website URLs
domains.description: One per line, e.g. stripe.com or https://www.notion.so. Only the homepage is fetched (robots.txt respected); DNS records are public.

checkWebsite.title: Detect website technologies
checkWebsite.description: Fetch the homepage and detect CMS, frameworks, analytics, ads pixels, chat, payments, consent tools, CDN and hosting.

checkDns.title: Detect email & SaaS from DNS
checkDns.description: Read public MX, SPF, TXT verification, DMARC and NS records: email provider, email sending tools, verified SaaS (Atlassian, Slack, DocuSign...), DNS provider.

maxConcurrency.title: Domains processed in parallel
maxConcurrency.description: How many domains are analyzed at the same time.
